proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A O B C X Y _ h1 h2 hX hY
  have key : ∀ w ∈ (affineSpan ℝ ({O, B, C} : Set P)).direction, inner ℝ (A -ᵥ O) w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℝ (show O ∈ ({O, B, C} : Set P) by simp)] at hw
    induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · simp
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [inner_add_right, hx, hy, add_zero]
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [real_inner_smul_right, hx, mul_zero]
  exact key _ (AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hY hX)
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A O B C X Y : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({O, B, C} : Set P) → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ O) (B -ᵥ O) = 0 → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ O) (C -ᵥ O) = 0 → X ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({O, B, C} : Set P) → Y ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({O, B, C} : Set P) → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ O) (Y -ᵥ X) = 0
